## Motivation (AI generated)

Many Capacitor apps now start on Lovable, Bolt, v0 or Cursor. These teams already deploy a static SPA and do not want a native project, a CLI, bundle uploads or CI. A clear product name and a page that reads like a website-to-app product makes the offer easier to understand, while the page stays upfront about the static-build requirement, what is left out, and the store steps that stay manual.

## Business Impact (AI generated)

- Entry-level offer below Solo for the website-to-app segment, under a searchable product name.
- Clear upgrade path to full Capgo plans from app settings.
- SEO and LLM-readable surfaces (page, pricing.md, blog post) for "website to app" queries; the old URL keeps working.
